What to say: State that Super Duper Burgers operates 11 locations and seeks to occupy 737 Irving St, which has operated as a restaurant continuously since at least 2003 with six prior Planning approvals. Ask whether the application will be treated as a new formula retail use requiring full CUA or whether continuation-of-use provisions apply. Request guidance on neighborhood outreach, environmental review and hearing timeline. Bring site history records and the 2020 limited restaurant approval.

outcomes.original: Filing step: Submit DPH plan check application for the kitchen build-out with scaled drawings, equipment list, menu and finishes schedule. outcomes.original: Filing step: File the building permit application with DBI once the CUA is approved, with plans stamped by the architect and routed to Planning, DPH, SFFD and SFPUC. What to say: Submit the complete plan set with the BAN, property address and CUA Motion number. Include architectural, mechanical, electrical and plumbing sheets. Route the permit to Planning (zoning review), DPH (health plan check), SFFD (hood suppression and place of assembly if 50+ occupancy) and SFPUC (FOG interceptor). State that the project is tenant improvements for a restaurant with full cooking, and that the CUA for formula retail has been approved. Budget $800–$15,000 in permit fees (percentage of construction valuation) and 14–120 days for review. Licensed contractors will pull separate electrical, plumbing and mechanical permits.

outcomes.original: Filing step: After DPH plan check approval and construction is substantially complete, schedule the DPH pre-opening inspection and apply for the health permit to operate. What to say: Book the pre-opening inspection with the DPH plan reviewer at least two weeks in advance. Ensure the kitchen is fully built per approved plans: all equipment installed, hand sinks operational, hot water at 120°F, walls and floors sealed, trash enclosure ready. Have a certified food safety manager on staff (ServSafe or equivalent). Submit the health permit application online with the BAN, Location ID, EIN and proof of the food safety certification. The inspector will verify compliance and issue the permit. Budget $470 application fee (includes initial inspection) and $0 annual license fee for 2026–28.

outcomes.original: Estimated time: 120 to 300 days. Estimated government cost: $5,403 to $19,350. Notes: The timeline and cost cover the Conditional Use Authorization for formula retail and the health permit to operate, the two approvals in the entitlement path. The CUA takes 120–300 days from filing to approval when granted, including pre-application meeting, application preparation, environmental review, 30-day posted notice, Commission hearing and 30-day appeal period. The Yi Fang formula retail restaurant CUA at 645 Irving St took 279 days. The health permit is issued 14–45 days after plan check approval and final inspection. Government costs: CUA application estimated $3,100 (2026–27 CPI-adjusted, no construction), health plan check $2,207 (new restaurant, 8 hours), health permit application $470, business registration $55–$700 (tiered by gross receipts). These figures exclude the building permit (insufficient information to establish whether it is required), architect and contractor fees, and pre-CUA costs (entity formation $70–$150, EIN $0, seller's permit $0). The timeline is to approval; it is not a time to denial or withdrawal.
